about_short_description.short_description: Create, collaborate on, and explain compensation practices from day zero.

product.name: Team Leveling
product.description: A tool to standardize job tiers and bands across locations to maintain predictable and scalable compensation structures.

product.name: Planning
product.description: A platform feature that manages compensation cycles with real-time adjustments and budget adherence, eliminating spreadsheet errors.

product.name: Team Monitoring
product.description: A system for tracking equity grants and compensation adjustments to model growth scenarios and support talent strategy.

product.name: Total Rewards
product.description: A feature that provides transparent, personalized compensation and benefits visibility to employees, enhancing understanding of their total rewards.

product.name: Interactive Offers
product.description: An interactive platform for candidates to explore and understand their compensation offers, including salary, equity, bonuses, and benefits.

product.name: Integrations
product.description: APIs and connectors that link Complete’s platform with Applicant Tracking Systems, Human Resource Information Systems, and other HR tools.
